text: Scryer Arcane Guardians are guards located on the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City. They give directions to various locations within the city and attack players who have chosen to align themselves with the Aldor instead would they choose to enter the Tier.
Scroll of Teleport: Ravenholdt is looted from Scroll of Teleportation that is randomly spawned by Marin Noggenfogger in Hall of Shadows.
Scryer Guardians are Scryer blood elves located in the Sanctum of the Stars of Shadowmoon Valley.

Scroll of Spirit can be purchased for from: * in Elwynn Forest * in Stormwind City * in Tirisfal Glades * in Darkmoon Faire Staging Areas * in the Ghostlands This item can be looted from most level 5-18 Humanoid monsters. This item is created with Inscription:
Scryer Dragonhawks are dragonhawks located in the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Seal of the Dawn is a trinket that serves as an and increases attack power against undead enemies. As of the Cataclysm, the quests for earning it are no longer available, so new players cannot acquire it. However, players who completed the quests prior to the Cataclysm can still get a replacement if it has been destroyed. They can also acquire instead. As stated, wearing it will cause undead mobs in the Plaguelands (and their dungeons) to drop scourgestones; however, these items no longer serve any purpose.

:"A Crusader's judgement means death to his foes and strength unto his allies." Seal of the Crusader grants the Paladin a buff that increases his Attack Power and attack speed, but reduces damage done per swing.
Sear Magic is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

After imprisoning G'huun in the facility of Uldir, the titanic keepers of Zandalar built three grand seals in order to keep the Old God and its corruption locked away under Nazmir. These seals were built into the architecture of great pyramids spread out around the continent: one in Dazar'alor of Zuldazar, one in Atul'nazman of Nazmir and the last one in Atul'Aman of Vol'dun. All three pyramids face Uldir and at least two had roads running to the central facility at some point, but now each ends at the pit known as the Altar of Rot. The seal in Atul'Aman was destroyed by Mythrax the Unraveler long ago, while Atul'nazman was damaged by G'huun's minions. G'huun then ordered his blood trolls mi
The Secret Strength of the Frenzyheart is provided as an objective for Secret Strength of the Frenzyheart (quest). Previously it was created by combining Wolvar Berries with Thunderbrew's Hard Ale.

The Seat of the Triumvirate is a five-player dungeon in the city of Eredath, on the planet Argus. It has been attacked by ethereals and corrupted by the Void. This instance was released in patch 7.3.0.

The Seat of Ascension is a section of the Halls of Valor used to transform Valarjar shieldmaidens chosen by Eyir into the mythical Val'kyr. When the ritual is completed, the shieldmaiden's form is changed, becoming far more powerful in their ability to serve Odyn. One such aspirant was Hyrja, who was chosen by her mistress Eyir to receive the gift.

Seduction is a Sayaad ability granted by Command Demon. It mesmerizes a target and renders them unable to attack, cast, move, or use any other abilities. Any damage caused to the target has a chance to remove the effect.
__NOTOC__ Sedana is a blood elf artisan enchanting trainer located in the Court of the Sun in Silvermoon City.

__NOTOC__ Seldarria is a black dragon located near the volcano's peak in The Charred Vale, Stonetalon Mountains. She is currently being protected by circling Black Drakes. Like Onyxia, she is a brood mother bearing many young Black Dragon Whelps. Some of her children have become food for the pets of Houndmaster Jonathan and a number of her eggs have been destroyed. Her own fate, however, is unconfirmed.

Sele'na is a rare jinyu found wandering in the marshes of New Cifera in the Valley of the Four Winds. A notable drop is the Overgrown Lilypad, an item that grants one druid ability to a non-druid class based on role. It works similar to the druid ability Symbiosis and lasts for an hour. Sele'na is a pandarian champion.

Sense Undead is a paladin ability that tracked all undead targets on the minimap with red spots (). It can't track Forsaken undead players and is similar to Track Undead, the hunter ability. It is very useful in any area with plenty of undead, and gives the Paladin more awareness.

__NOTOC__ Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is a night elf quest giver located near the Ruins of Mathystra in the night elven zone of Darkshore. She asks adventurers to fight off the marauding Shatterspears. Before the Cataclysm, she was located on the road just west of Ameth'Aran.

Sentinel is an ability that enables an huntress to see through the eyes of her owl familiar, allowing her to spy on enemy positions. The owl will perch at a tree permanently, unless the tree is destroyed. Sentinel Owl is a hunter talent. The Sentinel's Companion is a reward from The Huntresses. During No Survivors, Dori'thur acts as a Sentinel owl.

Selin Fireheart is the first boss in the Magisters' Terrace instance. He is a Felblood elf. You are awarded 120 reputation with the Shattered Sun for killing him in normal. You are awarded 250 reputation with the Shattered Sun for killing him in heroic.
Senior Sergeant Eveningshade was a blood elf quest giver located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Selina Pickman is a Forsaken wandering around alongside Reginald Grimsford and Davitt Hickson in the Magic Quarter and the Trade Quarter in the Undercity.

Sentinel Hill Guards are human guards found in both Sentinel Hill and Moonbrook in Westfall. At Sentinel Hill, they combat first the gnolls and later the Defias Brotherhood. At Moonbrook, they are part of what is primarily an expeditionary force. They were present during the Legion Invasions. After establishing the Breadbasket Guild, one Sentinel Hill Guard is seen at Saldean's Farm with a pair of Stormwind Guards.

__NOTOC__ Seleria Dawncaller is a blood elf Holy paladin. Her Alliance counterpart is Bemora. Seleria, Merhean Sunfall and Lan'veros Furybrand have traveled to the Dranosh'ar Blockade bringing Light-infused Sun Spheres from Silvermoon City for the Horde champions shipping off to the Broken Shore.
Sentry Magzinga is a Highmountain tauren located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain. She also appears in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Sella Waterwise is a Highmountain tauren initially found outside the entrance to a drogbar cave at Whitewater Wash in Highmountain. Believing that the drogbar have taken her son, Moozy, she is yelling for them to give him back until the player delivers Moozy to her themselves. Sella, her husband Rordan and Moozy are later found in the Hammer's Cradle at Thunder Totem.

Selis' Silk Shirt is provided for free by Selis Silksong in the Lower City in Shattrath City during Free T-Shirt Day. The rest of the year, it can be purchased for from Skin-Me-Own-Coat Dibblefur in Booty Bay.
Senegos' Magical Tome is a flying tome found in the Azure Archives in the Azure Span.

Sergeant Ba'sha was a PvP accessories vendor located in the Valley of Strength in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. She sold items that were associated with honor ranking. Among these were scout tabards and trinkets. With the honor system revamp and the opening of the Hall of Legends, Sergeant Ba'sha was removed from the game.

Sentry Point is a scout tower built by Theramore and located on the mainland of Dustwallow Marsh just across the bridge from the citadel itself. The tower acts as its name suggests, watching the comings and goings on the road to Theramore. The point was once attacked by elementals sent by Cho'gall. Sentry Point was destroyed during the Attack on Theramore Isle by a bomb that Captain Wymor hoped would kill Garrosh Hellscream. Despite this, it is not destroyed in World of Warcraft.

:Not to be confused with the Sepulcher (a town in Silverpine Forest) or the Sepulcher of Knowledge (a library in Maldraxxus). The Sepulcher of the First Ones is the final raid instance of the Shadowlands expansion, located east of Zereth Mortis. It is an ancient place of power, containing secrets of the eponymous First Ones that the Jailer seeks to use to rewrite the rules of the universe.

The Serpent's Eye is crafted with Jewelcrafting from 10 Sparkling Shard (chance to create when prospecting ore from Pandaria). This item is also sold by the following vendors for 1 Spirit of Harmony: * at Shrine of Seven Stars * at Shrine of Two Moons This item would be bought with Zen Jewelcrafter's Token.
Serpent's Cunning was a pet ability available exclusively to the serpent family of hunter pets, increasing player spell power by 10%.

Sepulcher of the Sky is an area where the Skyhorn village of tauren honor their dead in Highmountain. The area is also a Highmountain Tauren digsite. Completing Oenia Skyhorn's quest line will permanently buff the player so that whenever they enter the area, the Bluewax kobold mobs will be neutral to them.

__NOTOC__ Serrated Bone Spike is the rogue class ability of the Necrolord Covenant. It's available to all rogues who join the Necrolords. This ability is also temporarily available during the Maldraxxus portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Champion the Cause and lasts until you finish the Maldraxxus storyline.

Sepsis is the rogue class ability of the Night Fae Covenant. It's available to all rogues who join the Night Fae. This ability is also temporarily available during the Ardenweald portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest Preparing for the Winter Queen and lasts until you finish the Ardenweald storyline.

of Auchindoun.]] The Sethekk are a faction of the arakkoa who believe themselves to be the true and most loyal followers of the master of all arakkoa. The nature of this master is unknown to outsiders; the arakkoa do not speak of him except to say that his mysteries are for the feathered people alone. The Sethekk were formed when Talon King Ikiss proclaimed himself Terokk reborn, and gathered the broken and crazed arakkoa cursed by Sethe to his cause. The Sethekk used Sethe's power to control Anzu, the Raven God; in an alternate timeline the ritual to control Anzu was halted by adventurers. As the arakkoa spiraled further into darkness, the Sethekk grew in power in arakkoa society. Eventuall
Severed Crimsonscale Heads can be fished from the waters surrounding Darkmoon Island.
Severed Azurefin Heads can be fished from the waters surrounding Darkmoon Island.
__NOTOC__ Sethrak Front is a campsite under the control of the Faithless in Nazmir. They appear to be looking for some sort of shadow magic in Nazmir to power up the Skycaller Gem.
Set Keystone Map: Court of Stars is sold by the Keystone Vendor for . It changes the Mythic Keystone's dungeon to Court of Stars.
Set Keystone Map: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds is sold by the Keystone Vendor for . It changes the Mythic Keystone's dungeon to Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Seven of Air is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Dance. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Dance trinket.
Seven of Earth is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Watcher. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Watcher trinket.
Seven of Fire is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Inferno. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Inferno trinket.
Seven of Frost is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Rime. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Rime trinket.

Sewa Mistrunner is a tauren fishing vendor located on the High Rise in Thunder Bluff. She attended the feast for the Highmountain tauren in the city. She was seen drinking with Etu Ragetotem. She was later trapped by the Void.

The Sha'tar, meaning "Born from Light" in Draenei, are a faction of powerful naaru led by A'dal. They rule over a rebuilt Shattrath City. With the help of the Aldor and the Scryers, they lead the battle against Illidan and the Burning Legion. The naaru are a part of the Army of the Light.

__NOTOC__ Seymour is a human master skinning trainer located in the Lower City of Shattrath City. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Seymour and his mother Agnes traveled to Nastrondir in Stormheim on the Broken Isles.

The Shade of Akama is the dark portion of Akama's soul that binds Akama to Illidan's service. The shade was a reflection of all of the wickedness and evil that resided within Akama's soul: his egoism, vanity, and the lust and greed for power and glory that shadowed his outer piety. Looking upon the shade, Akama knew that it was, in many ways, his true face, and the broken felt incomplete, weaker without the darker virtues the shade also embodied: Akama's power, pride, and ambition. It admires Illidan's singular vision and wants to annihilate all of its enemies, perhaps even Akama himself in time. The threat of the shade kept Akama in line. At Illidan's whim, the shade could be unleashed and
Shadescale Flyeaters are mana wyrms located in Suramar. They prey on Moonglow Locusts.

Shackle the Unworthy is the death knight class ability of the Kyrian Covenant. It's available to all death knights who join the Kyrian. This ability is also temporarily available during the Bastion portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Archon's Answer and lasts until you finish the Bastion storyline.

shadow priest using Shadowform in the Trading Card Game.]] Shadow priests (or shadowpriests) are priests whose powers derive from the Void instead of the Light. Shadow priests can be worshipers of many dark forces such as the loa or the Old Gods, or simply focus their art on shadowy magics and mental manipulation, understanding the necessity of balance between dark and light. But to truly understand such ancient, corruptive influence is to be driven mad. This is the state in which these dark priests thrive, embracing insanity and feeding off of the minds of their opponents to reach terrifying new limits. Shadow priests often stand out by assuming a Shadowform.

Shadow hunters (also written as shadowhunters or shadow-hunters) are masters of voodoo and shadow magic and were once the highest authority amongst trolls. Their spirit powers can both heal and curse, walking the line of dark and light in hope of saving the future of trollkind, doing whatever it takes to secure a future for their kin. The loa can channel themselves through the shadow hunters when they use their ceremonial rush'kah masks. The traditional shadow hunter weapon is a long double-bladed sword or glaive. Females are sometimes called shadow huntresses, but the title "shadow hunter" can be used by both men and women.

The Shadow Orb was a magical artifact imbued by the orc Shadow Council and given to Gul'dan, becoming his most coveted artifact. As Gul'dan's body was ripped to pieces by the Tomb's demonic guardians, the shadow orb was shattered into ten different fragments that became scattered throughout the underground Tomb of Sargeras. Almost 20 years later, the ten fragments were then found and pieced back together by the night elf warden, Maiev Shadowsong. Its subsequent fate is unknown. Maiev may or may not have it.

Shadow Embrace is an Affliction warlock talented passive ability that causes Shadow Bolt (or Drain Soul if talented) to apply a stacking magic debuff to the target, increasing their damage taken from the caster.

Shadow Hunter Ty'jin is a jungle troll found in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula where he directed Horde adventurers in taking out the Shattered Hand clan leadership in order to weaken the Fel Horde. He also occasionally visits Frostwall in where he directs the Commander to take out various threats throughout the continent. During the Fourth War, Ty'jin relocated to the Banshee's Wail in Dazar'alor. He helped the Horde establish a foothold at Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound on Kul Tiras by parleying with the Fogsail Freebooters, a group of pirates. Afterward, he decided to stick with the Horde adventurer.

After 90 seconds two Shadow Sight powerups appear on opposite sides of the Arena. Picking one up will briefly let you see stealthed and invisible characters, at the cost of slightly damaging your health. Prior to Patch 2.4.0, Shadow Sight would deal 2% of your total health every 5 seconds for its duration. In Patch 2.4.0, it was changed to its current settings.
Shadow Bite is a Felhunter ability. It causes shadow damage to a target. It is the Felhunter's starting ability and does not need to be trained.
Shadow Words (often abbreviated SW: ) are special Shadow abilities used by priests to damage and weaken opponents. There are two other types of Words: the Holy Word and the Power Word.
Shadow Word: Insanity is a talented priest ability, available at level 45. It is the Shadow version of Power Word: Solace.
Shadow Hunter Da'jul is a jungle troll located in Zul'jan Ruins and Burial Mound in Nazmir. He is on a mission to destroy Zardrax the Empowerer with Kal'dran.

The Shadowforge clan is a clan and family of Dark Iron dwarves affiliated to the larger Dark Iron clan. The family has left a long stain on Dark Iron history. The earliest known member was Iron Thane Shadowforge, who was by all accounts a cruel despot who tortured and killed many of his own people. The Shadowforge clan is the Dark Iron force currently present in the Badlands and Uldaman. Ambassador Infernus oversees their operation from Angor Fortress in the name of Ragnaros. After Moira Thaurissan reclaimed her position in Shadowforge City, Shadowforge dwarves are seen in Stormwind City and Drustvar.
The Shadowmoon Destroyer's Drape drops from Teron Gorefiend in the Black Temple.
Shadowmoon Darkweavers are fel orcs found in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Shadowmoon Ruins is a location seen on the Outland map in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. Little is known about it, and it wasn't visited in the game. It is unclear whether the name "Shadowmoon" refers to the zone or the orcish clan (although they are related).
Shadowmoon Champions are fel orcs found in the Black Temple. Killing a Shadowmoon Champion grants 15 reputation with Ashtongue Deathsworn.
Shadowmoon Riding Hounds are wolves found at Gorefiend's Vigil in the Black Temple. They are ridden by Shadowmoon Houndmasters.
Shadowmoon Harbingers are orc ghosts found in Shadowmoon Valley.
Shadowmoon Acolytes are found in the Shattered Halls. These can be mindcontrolled and buff the group with 105 shadow resistance or cast a Prayer of Healing that heals each party member for ~5k.
Shadowmoon Eye of Kilrogg can be found in the Ruins of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley.

The Shadowforge Lock can be found in the East Garrison of Blackrock Depths. It is a locking mechanism for a large overhead wheel that is apparently connected, via a chain, to one of two huge doors across the Dark Iron Highway at the entrance to Shadowforge City. Clicking on the lock causes it to lower, allowing the wheel to spin and the door to close. A passage inside the door then allows players to cross the highway and reach the West Garrison, the Manufactory and the Grim Guzzler, which are in the west side of Shadowforge City.

Shadowfrost refers to a type of magic wielded by priests and formerly by death knights and mages. It is a multi-school, combining the Frost and Shadow schools. Multi-school abilities benefit from bonuses that affect any of their schools, use the lowest resistance value among their schools, ignore absorption and immunity effects that apply to only some of their schools, and can be used even when one or more of their schools have been locked with an interrupt effect.
Shadowmoon Darkcasters are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping calls to the might of Shu'ma, summoning three differently colored globules of his blood. These globules path slowly towards Yor'sahj, infusing him with additional powers if they reach him. When a Shadowed Globule reaches Yor'Sahj, it infuses Yor'sahj with the Deep Corruption ability. Yor'sahj's Deep Corruption spreads to every player, causing every fifth healing or absorption effect cast on a player to trigger a violent detonation, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

The Shadowforge Senate is an assembly that serves as part of the government of the Dark Iron clan of Dark Iron dwarves, based from the Imperial Seat in Shadowforge City. Along with the position of Emperor, the senate forms the main ruling body of Dark Iron society, exercising a large amount of control over many areas within and around Blackrock Mountain.
Shadowmoon Fragment is found at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

Shadowmoon Burial Grounds is a dungeon introduced in Warlords of Draenor, set in within Anguish Fortress. It features Ner'zhul as its end boss. Following the defeat of the Dark Star, Ner'zhul and his followers retreated here.
Shadowmoon Burial Grounds: Gold is an achievement earned for completing the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode with a rating of Gold.
Shadowmoon Burial Grounds: Silver is an achievement earned for completing the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode with a rating of Silver or better.
Shadowmoon Burial Grounds: Bronze is an achievement earned for completing the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode with a rating of Bronze or better.
Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenger is an achievement earned for completing the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds Challenge Mode.
The Shadowmoon Exile Treasure chest is found at in the back of the Ancestors' Totem cave beneath Exile's Rise in north-central . It contains the Shadowmoon Astrologer's Almanac.
Shadowmoon Mine is a cave mine in Anguish Fortress. Here, adventurers reconstruct the Dream of Argus. It is on the opposite side of the Terrace of the Stars from the entrance.
Shadowmoon Clan Invasion is an achievement earned when a player successfully completes a Shadowmoon Clan garrison invasion.
Shadowmoon Rise is a mountain located outside the Den of Secrets in .
Shadowmoon Bone-Menders are orcs located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Shadowmoon Loyalists are orcs located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Shadowmoon Enslavers are orcs located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Shadowmoon Exhumers are orcs located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Shadowmoon Retainers are fel orcs located in Shadowmoon Valley during The Ata'mal Terrace.
Shadowmoon Hides drop from Shadowmoon Stalkers and Shaded Plainstalkers in .
Shadowmoon Ancestors are orc ghosts located at the Burial Fields in . They are seen walking around with a Shadowmoon Ghost Wolf.
Shadowmoon Ghost Wolves are spirit wolves located in the Burial Fields in . They are pets of Shadowmoon Ancestors.
Shadowmoon Slam: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Outland Shadowmoon Slam.
Shadowmoon Slam: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Outland Shadowmoon Slam.
Shadowmoon Slam: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Outland Shadowmoon Slam.
Shadowmoon Blood Mages are fel orcs found in the Black Temple. They use blood magic. Killing one will grant 15 reputation with Ashtongue Deathsworn.

.]] Shadowmoon Valley is found in southeastern Outland, east of Terokkar Forest. It is the location of the Black Temple (where Illidan Stormrage resides), and also houses a dwarven settlement named after (and led by) Kurdran Wildhammer, as well as the prison where Illidan's former jailor, Maiev Shadowsong, is held captive. It is one of the darkest, bleakest, and most fel-affected regions in the Warcraft universe, second only to Argus. The sky is always black and ghastly yellow, lightened up by the never-ceasing rain of infernals.
Shadowmoon Tubers can be found north of Oronok's Farm in Shadowmoon Valley. Only his specially trained boars can dig them up, using Oronok's Boar Whistle will call one to do so.
__NOTOC__ Shadowsworn Defilers are eredar that appeared at the Legion Invasion locations. They also appear in Highmountain Burial Ground in Highmountain.
Shadowmoon Soulstealers are fel orcs located in Shadowmoon Valley.
Shadowmoon Slam Advanced: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Outland Shadowmoon Slam Advanced.
Shadowmoon Slam Advanced: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Outland Shadowmoon Slam Advanced.
Shadowmoon Slam Advanced: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Outland Shadowmoon Slam Advanced.
Shadowmoon Slam Reverse: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing Outland Shadowmoon Slam Reverse.
Shadowmoon Slam Reverse: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Gold ranked time for Outland Shadowmoon Slam Reverse.
Shadowmoon Slam Reverse: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by getting Silver ranked time for Outland Shadowmoon Slam Reverse.

in the Trading Card Game.]] Totems are tools used by a shaman as an instrument of war. Characterized by their immobility and area of effect, the totems embody the shaman's mastery over the elements. Some totems possess destructive power while others aid and assist allies. Shamanistic cultures outside those of the Horde and Alliance also possess the ability to use totems in battle.

A large, twisting naga lair south of Feathermoon Stronghold's island at the northern end of the Isle of Dread. The master of the Hatecrest, Shalzaru, dwells deep inside. The cave consists of a main cave and a smaller cave. They are connected by a waterway. The cave is filled with Hatecrest Sorceresses and Hatecrest Serpent Guards.

A shaman trainer is an NPC that offers shamans the opportunity to train abilities and reset their talent points. A general rule-of-thumb for finding the local Shaman trainer is to search the city's more naturalistic and open areas. Druid trainers are usually found alongside them in such places.
__NOTOC__ Shalenn is a blood elf stable master located at Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.
__NOTOC__ Shard of the Splithooves is an trinket which gives both mana regeneration and health regeneration when equipped.

The Shan'ze are a clan of mogu found in Townlong Steppes, the Jade Forest, and the Isle of Thunder. They operate from the dark island of Shan'ze Dao, where they make plans to assault Niuzao Temple to the south to claim the entire region of Townlong Steppes. Eventually, led by Shan Bu, the Shan'ze launched a devastating assault on Niuzao Temple and the surrounding area, which left the Pandaren defenders decimated. However, with the help of adventurers, Niuzao managed to drive back the Mogu north. It was then Shan Bu heard the news of Lei Shen's return, and he looked forward to serving his emperor once again. Shan Bu has taken the majority of his clan, which is currently the largest of all Mog
Shara Felbreath is a Highmountain tauren vignette and a warlock of the Feltotem tribe found at an isolated hut east of Torok's Bluff in Highmountain.

The Shards of Domination are the shattered pieces of the Helm of Domination. The one to shatter the helm was Sylvanas Windrunner. They are located atop Icecrown Citadel, and one shard was taken to the Shadowlands during the war against the Jailer. Within the Maw, the shard taken to the Shadowlands was used to gain information from shades, but the effort was mostly useless as the shadows didn't survive. Afterward, there was an attempt on stronger being, Tormented Amalgamation which the adventurer could control longer and brought it back to the cave. Darion Mograine interrogated the amalgamation after Anduin Wrynn was freed. During the interrogation, the Amalgamation gave information about the

Shatter is a Frost mage ability. It multiplies the critical strike chance of all the mage's spells against frozen targets by 1.5 plus an additional 50%. A frozen target is a target immobilized by a frost-based effect, such as Frost Nova, Freeze, Freezing Trap or the freeze effect from the Freezing Band. The critical strike chance applies to all of the mage's spells, including those not in the Frost school.

Shatter Scar Vale lies north of the Bloodvenom Falls in Felwood. Shatter Scar Vale is where many of the demonic infernals fell to Azeroth during the invasion of the Burning Legion during the Third War. Still-smoldering craters dot the vale, and demons still wander the scarred landscape.

Shattered Halls Key opens the gate to The Shattered Halls, the third instance in Hellfire Citadel in Hellfire Peninsula. The gate is outside the instance portal, so only one player in the party needs the key (alternatively, a rogue with a lockpicking skill of 350 can open the door).
Shattered Hand Captains are fel orc captains of the Shattered Hand clan in Hellfire Peninsula.
Shattered Necklace Power Source drops from Archaedas in Uldaman.

holding Shargahn]] Shargahn is the massive horn held by Golganneth the Thunderer. This massive horn is crafted of some silvery, alien material; light reflecting from its surface breaks into its component colors in a stunning display. Golganneth carries Shargahn, and the horn can shatter mountains, summon storms of incredible fury and beckon the creatures of the deep.
Shattered Hand Centurion are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Champions are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Legionnaires are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls.
The Shattered Hand Executioner can be found in the Shattered Halls. He only appears on Heroic, and he was part of the now-removed attunement quest for The Eye.
This is a page listing loot to be found in The Shattered Halls. For information about the instance itself, see Shattered Halls. __TOC__

Shattered Barrier is a Mage talent in the Frost tree that gives a 100% chance that Ice Barrier will trigger a Frost Nova-like freezing effect upon being destroyed by enemy attacks. It requires, obviously, that one take the Ice Barrier talent.
Shatter Resistant is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Volkhan in the Halls of Lightning on Heroic difficulty without allowing him to shatter more than 4 Brittle Golems.
Shattered (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Ignis the Furnace Master after shattering 2 Iron Constructs within 5 seconds on 10-player mode.

Sharing a Bountiful Feast is a one-off introductory quest for the Pilgrim's Bounty festival. You are invited to sit at one of the tables and eat and share the food. When you have eaten five pieces of each of the five different foods within five minutes, you will have fulfilled this quest. The quest is offered at each of the major cities of your faction, but when you have completed it in one city, you cannot repeat it in another city. This quest unlocks the quest chain.
Shattered Hand Brawlers are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Assassins can be found in the Shattered Halls from the Sparring Halls until Warchief Kargath Bladefist. They are level 69-70 in normal mode, and 70-71 on heroic mode.
Shattered Crystal Pendants are looted from Talrendis Saboteurs at Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara.
Shattered Hand Heathen are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Houndmasters are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Reavers are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls.
__NOTOC__ Shattered Hand Savages are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Sentries are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Sharpshooters are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Gladiators are fel orcs located in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Archers are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Shattered Hand Blood Guards are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls. He only appears in the normal instance, whereas his Heroic replacement is Blood Guard Porung.
Shattered Hand Zealots are fel orcs found in the Shattered Halls.
Sharinga Springrunner is the flight master located at The Summer Terrace of Shrine of Seven Stars, in the contested territory of Vale of Eternal Blossoms. She appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Shattered Beachhead is a small outpost that was established in response to the Iron Horde attack on Nethergarde Keep, found north of the Shattershore battlefield. This location is only available to players level 90 or above.
Shattered Hand Spoils is found at behind a stash of crates on the Shattered Rise in east-central Spires of Arak.
The Shattered Front is an area just beyond the Shattershore in the Blasted Lands. It's controlled by the Iron Horde.

Shatter the Bones is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Intolerance and Strength of the Earth Aspect traits.

a type of sheep on the Dragon Isles.]] Sheep are woolly critters similar to a goat, but smaller than a cow. Shattering Throw is a row 5 warrior class talent that deals ranged damage or removes any invulnerabilities. It is an exclusive choice node with Wrecking Throw.

Shatterspear Overseers are jungle trolls of the Shatterspear Tribe found at the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.
Shatterspear Shaman are level 13 - 14 jungle trolls of the Shatterspear Tribe found at the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.

Shattrath City Center is the central crossroads of , connecting the Sha'tar Way Station, Shattrath Commons, Sha'tari Market District, and Shattrath Residential District. It resembles a flooded version of the main city, presumably found under the dome.

Shevan Manille is a temporary flight master who spawns in Stormshield Stronghold, Ashran, upon the defeat of the Alliance faction leader Grand Marshal Tremblade. She will fly Horde players back to Warspear Outpost, providing an opportunity to escape to safety before the zone and its NPCs reset.

Shattered Sun Veterans are blood elves located in Shattrath City.

The harbor serves as the Vol'dun entrance point for Alliance players and provides basic facilities, such as an innkeeper, repair vendor, and a flight master. After the armistice with the Horde was signed at the end of the Fourth War, the Alliance ceded control of the encampment.

Shatterspear Speakers are jungle troll emissaries of the Shatterspear tribe located at the Terrace of the Speakers in Dazar'alor. One was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation. She was seen dancing.

The Shining Strand is the name of the section of shoreline of Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest. It stretches from the Lordaeron capital city in the north and ends at the range of rough hills that divides Silverpine from the Alterac Mountains. The Vile Fin tribe of murlocs used to have several settlements along the strand making it very dangerous for unseasoned travelers, until they moved to the Dawning Isles. In his journal, the late Apothecary Berard spoke of a rare item that could be obtained from the Vile Fins, a Hardened Tumor. Berard speculated that the tumor could be used in the concoction of a new plague. The Forsaken, likely having forced the murlocs out, have setup several camps
Shields of Silver is a shop found in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. It shares space with Plate and Mail Protection.

Shielded Anchors are fel crystals in the Broken Shore during The Battle for Broken Shore (quest). They must be destroyed to stop demonic reinforcements and are invulnerable while protected by Eredar Chaos Guards. They also appeared during the Assault on Broken Shore.
Shimmering Scales is a special pet ability available exclusively to the Lesser Dragonkin family of hunter pets, reducing pet magic damage taken by 70% for 8 sec.
Shimmering Shale is a passive exotic ability of Hunter pets in the Shale Beast family. ;Shale Beast abilities

The Shodo-Pan was a fake Warcraft III hero unit. They were described as mighty pandaren warriors that oversee the armies of their empire and serve as feudal lords to the general population. Shodo-Pans have the ability to wield geomantic powers as well as the wardancers' shaktani blades. The stoic Shodo-Pans' greatest enemies are the cruel centaur khans of southern Kalimdor. The Pans ceaselessly work to hunt down the khans and their centaur marauders whenever they encroach upon the lands of the pandaren empire.

The shivarra, or shivan, are a tall 6-armed female demonic species. Devout and exceedingly charismatic, these priestesses live only to evangelize the power of Sargeras' dread vision. They are the driving heart of the Burning Crusade and are thought to be three times as fanatical as the other demons. The most powerful shivarra are the Coven of Shivarra.

Shirvallah is a Zandalari tiger loa, also revered by the Gurubashi and Darkspear trolls. Shirvallah's last champion was the Zandalari High Priest Thekal. At some point in the past, Shirvallah's previous Zandalari high priest wielded the Warmace of Shirvallah, a brutal Zandalari mace with an ornate frame which claimed many lives in an unbidden attempt to honor Shirvallah. Long ago, it was lost to the sea with the high priest who wielded it. In modern times, in order to quell Hakkar the Soulflayer, King Rastakhan sent powerful champions of the loa, the Zandalari High Priests serving Hir'eek, Shadra, Hethiss, Bethekk and Shirvallah, into the ancient city of Zul'Gurub. Despite their best efforts
Shipwreck Debris is a fishing pool which primarily contains Sealed Crates. These pools can be found in the coastal waters of Tol Barad and Darkmoon Island.
Sho the Wise is a pandaren monk trainer at Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City.
Shortride the Cloudrunner is a Highmountain tauren flight master for Talonrest in Stormheim.

The Shipping Contract drops from Emery Camden while on Lost Shipment, part of The Pride of Kul Tiras storylne. While skimming the contract, Flynn Fairwind noted that it contains ten pages of security measures, twenty pages of liability conditions, and within the mess of legalese and double-talk "legal mumbo-jumbo that would never hold up in court unless the judge were crooked".

.]] Goblin shredders or simply shredders are goblin inventions designed to harvest lumber often replacing lumberjacks. Goblin shredders already existed in the aftermath of the Second War, but started being more widely used in the Third War and Ashenvale war. The Super Reaper 6000, seen in Stonetalon Mountains and around Venture Bay, may be an upgrade of the shredder. During the Fourth War, a new type of shredders appeared, being empowered by :Azerite.

Shrine of the Ancients was a shrine on an island in the ocean which was dedicated to unknown gods in the official Blizzard Warcraft III bonus map called Shrine of the Ancients. There once existed a shrine to the ancient gods of lore, but all that remains is a ruin of rubble, sand, and ore. Legends persist of creatures from the sea that have surfaced to guard the treasures of an era long before.

The Shrine of Eldretharr is the final area within Dire Maul East. It is a large open-air temple containing the felvine, numerous ancients and lashers. Its most notable occupant is Alzzin the Wildshaper, the last boss of the wing. To access this area, one has to get Old Ironbark to break down the door in the Conservatory. After Alzzin's defeat, a direct tunnel access leading back out to the Broken Commons opens. Alzzin corrupted the Highborne Shrine of Eldretharr and the Fruit of Fertility, using its power to shape illusions all his own. With his success, Alzzin became feared as the Wildshaper, for his power over the enslaved protectors of nature. Wandering adventurers killed him at some poin

Shrine of the Tempest is a shrine at the very west of Sholazar Basin, above the Maker's Perch. Players bring Essence of the Monsoon and Essence of the Storm (Sholazar Basin) here to make True Power of the Tempest for the quest Strength of the Tempest.

The Shrine of Aviana is a shrine built to honor Aviana. Found on the Rim of the World in central Mount Hyjal it serves as a safe haven for all winged creatures and as a base for the Druids of the Talon under the direction of Skylord Omnuron. The Wormwing harpies once sheltered themselves in the boughs of the shrine, but have turned against the druids since the Twilight's Hammer assault upon the mountain. The Shrine of Aviana comes under attack by the Burning Legion. However, this is only a distraction while the Legion works to corrupt Goldrinn in Moonglade. The Legion attacks the shrine a second time to steal the Idol of Aviana, during which it is revealed that Skylord Shadegrove is actually
The following NPCs can be found in the Horde city in Pandaria, Shrine of Two Moons.

Instance= |-| Lore= The Shrine of the Storm (or the Shrine of the Storms) is a monumental temple located on an island in eastern Stormsong Valley. It is the seat of House Stormsong and the stronghold of the Tidesages. It is also a dungeon, while the Crucible of Storms raid is located underneath it. According to Xal'atath, the area of the Precipice of Oblivion, where Storm's End and the Shrine of Shadows is found, has had countless names over the ages and echoes with ancient power.
Shroud of Forbidden Magic is created with Classic Tailoring (300); taught by Ancient Pattern: Shroud of Forbidden Magic.
Sickle of Unyielding Strength is part of the Battlegear of Unyielding Strength set.
Siegemakers are artillery weapons used by the Iron Horde. Powered by iron stars, their frame can be modified for troop transports rather than cannons.
Silithid wasps are the flying attack troops of the silithid. They are very aggressive and can often be found in swarms. There is also a much smaller version of them, always flying near the nests.
Signet of Unyielding Strength is part of the Battlegear of Unyielding Strength set.

Silencing Shot is a Marksmanship hunter ability, available at level 30. It is an instant shot that silences the target for 3 seconds, and will interrupt spells being cast even if the target is immune to silence effects. The shot is off the global cooldown, allowing it to used "in between" other shots. The ability replaces Counter Shot.
Silas Zimmer is a Forsaken located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. He's standing in the Temple of the Damned, exactly at the opposite side of Hannah Akeley.

Silgryn (pronounced "SIHL-grihn") is a nightborne spell-fencer (swordsman) located in Suramar. He is initially a guard in Suramar City, patrolling the outer city with his pet owl Kal, before joining First Arcanist Thalyssra's rebellion against Grand Magistrix Elisande.
The Sign of the Warrior is a buff that is available during the Dragonflight Dungeon Event (Bonus Event). It adds an additional item drop at the final boss for each Dragonflight dungeon.
Silisthra's Power Stone is located near, and empowering, Lady Silisthra at the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara.

Silver Piffeny Band can be bought for from the following vendors: * Qixdi Goodstitch in Booty Bay * Arred in the Exodar * Gelanthis in Silvermoon City

The Silvermoon Remnant was a planned reputation faction which included certain high elves found in-game, but not all of them. The term has received only a single reference in the patch 1.6 notes, and nowhere else. High Elves now have their own distinct faction -- "Silvermoon Remnant". This faction is allied with the Alliance and is at war with the Horde. Not all High Elves are a part of this faction. Beyond the single reference to the faction in the patch notes, no references appear in-game, and there is no knowledge as to what particular high elves belonged to it. Nor is there any information regarding whether Blizzard still considers it an official group. Unlike other non-rep factions like

Silverwing Emissaries are night elf Warsong Gulch recruiters located at various spots throughout the largest Alliance cities - Stormwind City, Exodar, Darnassus, and Ironforge, as well as the neutral Shattrath City during the monthly Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch.

Silverwind Refuge is located in south-central Ashenvale, just north of Mystral Lake and directly south of the Remains of Iris Lake and Thunder Peak. It is a Horde outpost with a flight master, an innkeeper, quest givers, a stable master, and vendors. The corpses of some of the previous inhabitants still lie on the ground around the outpost. The main building that functions as an inn has a beautiful view on the lake that borders it. The quest We're Here to Do One Thing, Maybe Two... from Blood Guard Aldo Rockrain begins the Horde quest line for Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Sindrayl is a night elf hippogryph flight master located south of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.
Simon Arizpe is the author of The Hearthstone Pop-Up Book. He has previously written pop-up books for settings such as Star Wars and the DC Universe.

__NOTOC__ Sinful Brand is the demon hunter class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all demon hunters who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.
__NOTOC__ Simon Sezdans is a human located at the South Pavilion on Darkmoon Island.

The Singing Pools are a series of magical pools in the east on the Wandering Isle. The spirits of animals that have died in them have infused the water of five of the area's pools with shapeshifting magic, causing anyone that steps into the water to take the forms of those animals. In one of the deep pools, Fang-she guards an Ancient Clam, which holds the :Sun Pearl. Rumor has it that Shu, the ancient water spirit, has a liking for such pearls. Balance poles can be found in the western pools where Tushui Monks are found practicing. It's also said the reeds in the Singing Pools are the hardest in all the lands.

, the Sin-Stained Goliath.]] Sinstone golems (or sinstone constructs) are golems made out of sinstones, found in Revendreth. They are generated through the unresolved sins of those souls who failed their redemption and were condemned to the Maw. They can grow more powerful if exposed to anima. Sinstone fragments—which naturally contain anima—eventually amalgam into golems on their own, but the venthyr can use alchemy to accelerate the process. The nature of the golem depends on the sins contained in the fragments: some strengthen the amalgamation, while others increase its resilience. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Sir Barton Brigham is a worgen located in Island Expeditions. Despite being part of the Island pack, he seems to be fully in control of himself.

Sishir Canyon is an empty canyon that leads from the main road in the Stonetalon Mountains to the Ruins of Eldre'thar. Sishir Canyon was previously a canyon completely taken over by monstrous Deepmoss spiders. Their eggs and webbing densely covered the whole area, and deep inside, the most powerful of their number Besseleth awaited. When Stonetalon was redesigned this area became the opened up Webwinder Hollow and a new canyon was added and given the same name just west of it.

A skeletal creature is the reanimated bone structure of a formerly living creature, a type of undead. Necromantic magic powers the skeleton, forcing it back into a parody of its living self. Most skeletons are mindless automatons, servants of necromancers or other spellcasters, but a few possess some degree of sentience and free will. A skeleton is seldom garbed in anything more than the rotting remnants of any clothing or armor it was wearing when slain. A mindless skeleton does only what it is ordered to do; it can draw no conclusions of its own and has no iniative. Because of this limitation, its instructions must always be simple. The Skeletal Coast (or the Coast of Bones) was where the Devouring Sea met what is now Shadowmoon Valley. During the Invasion of Draenor, a force of the Alliance Expedition landed there in order to prepare for an assault on Fortress Shadowmoon.
The Sisters of the Moon are the fifth encounter in Tomb of Sargeras. They are a huntress, a ranger and a priestess of the Moon.

Siward was a member of the crew on the Bold Arva commanded by Flynn Fairwind that aided Mathias Shaw in his mission to check the coasts of Zandalar for signs that the Banshee loyalists were on the continent. He was a gunner, being in charge of the defense of the ship.
Skeletal Ward is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. This power summons a Skeletal Ward to fight for the adventurer.

Six of Fire is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Inferno. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Inferno trinket.
Six of Earth is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Watcher. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Watcher trinket.
Six of Air is 1 of the 8 cards needed to complete the Darkmoon Deck Dance. The complete set when combined awards the Darkmoon Deck: Dance trinket.

The Sketh'lon Wreckage is located southeast of Shadowmoon Village in northwestern Shadowmoon Valley. It is filled with the roaming ghosts of the arakkoan members of the Dark Conclave who used to live here.
